scope: Committed opt-in debugExport dates/labels encoder, fifth option and existing storage-only hooks
findings: Fifth includeLabels option defaults false in both Legacy registration and shared schema; existing JSON/types/redaction/dates defaults remain.
Metadata encoder is selected only by includeDates or includeLabels; ordinary default output path is retained.
Label opt-in with redaction disabled requests only log label storage through the existing backfill hook, without preview label context rewrites and without Release instrumentation.
Range association uses monotone item/label traversal with explicit kind, cardinality, integer, ordering, overlap and bounds checks.
Per-item Creation Date is read from the actual item; the current date is used only as a type witness, and unsupported or ambiguous metadata stays explicit.
Redacted labels are emitted without collecting their private values.
Native Creation Date behavior and actual File carrier remain external proof obligations; source/model tests do not supply Apple execution credit.
